name: local-business-website
title: Local Business Website
description: Specialised playbook for local service businesses: HVAC, plumbing, roofing, pest control, landscaping, electricians, contractors, home and professional services.
when_to_use: The client is a local or service-area business whose customers call or book a visit.
instructions: Lead with the jobs customers hire for (repair, install, maintenance, emergency) and the service area; make calling and booking one tap away.
Service pages per core service; service-area signals without doorway pages; transparent process (what happens on a visit).
Trust comes from verifiable facts only: licences, years, reviews, guarantees appear only if confirmed; otherwise placeholders listed for the client.
Seasonal and emergency needs (no heat, no cooling, leaks) addressed plainly.
